evidence.text:
Why this deck fits the audit leg
Source: Pitch Deck Hunt lists ManyChat as a 2015 Series A deck with $23.1M raised. The embedded SlideShare deck has 10 slides. ManyChat’s current site is active under Manychat, Inc. and describes current products across Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, and Messenger.
Stage
Series A
Company status
Active private company
Audit use
Private-company source deck
Deck length
10 slides
Use this as the third audit deck after Nike / Ben & Jerry’s to check how Zelda handles a live private company with older public fundraising materials.
